criteria.reason: Read as a whole, the edit retains the staging evidence and its limits, the old/new cursor-upload causal distinction, unchanged production state and the approval-dependent limited pilot. Staffing, timing, mismatch investigation with retained files and a separate release decision remain coherent and faithful. No unsupported assurance or changed action boundary is communicated.

The reader now reaches the approval request first, then the staging evidence and causal explanation, limits and executable pilot plan. Compared with the fragmented source, this makes the same bounded decision easier to make and retains an actionable stop/retain warning with its reason and separate release decision.

The whole edit gives the reader a direct path from decision to evidence/causal explanation, limits and pilot action. The mechanism is explained once; the limited-release reminder appears with its supporting uncertainty and the success branch. These connections support decision and execution without the source’s digression or dispersed duplicate explanation. The document is easy to consume, not merely decipherable.

procedural_summary: Editing process is unscored under CW-assessment-4. Preserved execution traces remain available as setup and action evidence; no process criterion contributes to the outcome.

observations.description: Policy-4 whole-document review retains the F1–F3 passing judgments after explicitly assessing unnecessary consumption burden. Length remains separate. Original inputs, saved output, execution and raw evidence are unchanged; prior rule versions and judgments remain in Git.
